finding: Same-type rule: one active effect per type, chosen by spell value times effectiveness (ties go to the newcomer). Weaker buffs from another caster are parked and wake when the active one ends; weaker debuffs are refused (EffectListComponent.cs:790-845, :937)

NPC stun ladder: first stun full, later stuns in the window get base / (2 x count), refused under 1000 ms (ECSImmunityEffect.cs:43-55; CCSpellHandler.cs:283-325). Players get no ladder, only an immunity window after a hard CC and no second stun while one is active (CCSpellHandler.cs:281; ECSGameSpellEffect.cs:79)

Stat modifiers: each effect writes into a category per property; debuffs erode buffs first, then base and item stat at a lower rate; player buff totals capped by level (StatCalculator.cs:33, :67, :98; GameLiving.cs:2203)

Fear: NPC-only brain pushed onto the brain stack, re-planned every 3,000 ms, walks 300 units from the nearest player; a second fear can orphan a brain (not verified; FearBrain.cs:30-59; FearSpellHandler.cs:46-88)

Bleed: DoT whose tick falls by one per pulse, floor one, resist per tick, does not start combat (BleedECSEffect.cs:17, :32, :42-43; StyleBleeding.cs:30). Snare and root are one class; root at 99 or more; roots never crit (SpeedDecreaseSpellHandler.cs:45-74)

Defects with fixes: stat-debuff stop calls base.OnStartEffect (StatDebuffECSEffect.cs:54, no effect today); style-stun x5 immunity lives in a legacy hook the ECS stun does not call (StyleStun.cs:45-47); fear map overwrite (FearSpellHandler.cs:64, :66)

Stag self-buff: extra max HP near a tenth of max HP with a random factor, race model swap, drained on expiry (StagECSEffect.cs:35, :41, :62). Client art, icons and sound not in the box; spell rows not in the box
One poison slot per target; a monster cannot poison its own family; some equipment and one skill block poison; NPC poison proc is 12 percent per hit (L1Poison.java:35-56; L1Attack.java:1188-1193)

Curse paralysis is a telegraphed three-phase state: windup (poison tint, server message), timed lock, cure. Player windup 8 s and lock 16 s; monster windup 0 and lock 16 s; refused under earth bind, ice lance, freezing blizzard or freezing breath (L1SkillUse.java:2054-2059; L1CurseParalysis.java:107-110)

Shock stun and bleed each draw one weighted number from 400 into four buckets (stun 1/2/3/4 s; bleed 1/4/6/8 s). Bleed is 5 damage per second and never takes HP below one (L1SkillUse.java:2101-2108; L1Bleed.java:55-86)

Defect with fix: curse and poison paralysis set the lockout flag and kill it in the same call, so the re-curse guard never sees it (L1CurseParalysis.java:82-84, :121; L1ParalysisPoison.java:74-75). Fix: a timed lockout

Defect with fix: blocking Thread.sleep in the curse windup on a pool thread (L1CurseParalysis.java:56); interrupt path returns without cure (:58-59). Fix: schedule the lock as a second step and cure on interrupt

Skill-effect timers tick once per second and round the length down to whole seconds; a re-application replaces only if longer, and a zero-time flag stays until killed (L1SkillTimerTimerImpl.java:21, :27; L1Character.java:402-407)

Stat debuffs add straight into stats with no categories or caps (Panic -1 to all five; Weakness -5 damage; Disease -6 damage and +12 AC). Damage and hit keep the true sum and clamp only on use (L1Panic.java:7, :18; L1Character.java:900-902)
Absent in the server half read: fear, knockback, knockdown and stagger mechanics (grep over 775 Java files). RESIST_FEAR appears only as a skill-adjustment term (L1Attack.java:479-483)
